chapter: Learning clarinet and the Eureka band
title: First E-flat clarinet and the Eureka Brass Band
summary: Lewis describes his first time on E-flat clarinet in 1919, the Eureka band's organizers, leaders and trumpeters, and brass bands that did not play jazz.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
